intention: 告诉对方等完成A任务后就开始B任务
naturalChunk: Once I finish [task], I'll start [next action]
avoidSaying: After I done X, I'm going to do Y
sentencePatterns: Once I finish the [analysis/review/deployment], I'll start [merging/testing/...].
Once I'm done with X, I'll move on to Y.
realLifeExamples: Once I finish the memory leak analysis, I'll start merging the version 3 code.
Once I finish the code review, I'll start working on the deployment script.
usageNotes: once 引导时间从句用现在时表将来（主将从现）；比 after 更强调'一完成就立刻'的紧接感
productionPrompts: 告诉同事：等我做完这个PR review，就去处理那个线上告警
